read: Read: a managed hedge cycle, not a new bet. As prices fell, hedgers cashed the puts that worked (SPX 7750/7650, part of SPY's 10/27 $767s) and bought protection further down (QQQ $680–690, SPY $735 and the Monday 755/750 spread, maybe SPX 7600/7500). IWM's November puts held.
